title: Lesson 6. I've been waiting
subtitle: Present Perfect или Present Perfect Continuous; в магазине одежды

sections.title: 1. Which tense?
sections.text: If an action has {finished} and the {result} is important, we use the {Present Perfect}: {have / has} + {V3}. If an action is {unfinished} and the {time period} is more important than the result, we use the {Present Perfect Continuous}: {have been / has been} + {V-ing}. Compare: I have {already found} a T-shirt (the result is important). I've been {trying on} these clothes (I am still doing it). I've been waiting for you {for ages}. To {try something on} means to put on clothes in a shop to see if they fit.
chain: unfinished + time period → Present Perfect Continuous

sections.title: 2. In the department store
sections.text: Nick has been {waiting} for Rosie for ages. Rosie has been {trying on} clothes and she hasn't {decided} yet. Nick says: You've been {choosing} for hours! Rosie has already {found} a T-shirt for the party, but she needs a {skirt}. Nick suggests a {striped} one. Rosie thinks it is too {long}, but Nick says it is {knee-length} and looks very {smart}. At last Rosie says: All right, I'll take the {skirt} too. Then they go to the {sports} department.
chain: Nick: I've been waiting for ages
Rosie: I've been trying on clothes
Rosie: I have already found a T-shirt
Nick: Have you tried it on?

sections.title: 3. An e-mail to Kate
sections.text: Bill {has caught} a cold, so he {has been lying} in bed all day. Hanna {has bought} a new dress in an online shop. The dress is too tight, so she {has been doing} morning exercises for two weeks and {has been trying} to lose weight. Alice {hasn't seen} Dave and Ted for two weeks. They {have been shopping} since the end-of-the-year sales started, but they {haven't bought} anything yet.
chain: has been lying in bed all day (period)
has been doing exercises for two weeks

flashcards.a: Действие закончилось, важен результат: I have already found a T-shirt.
Действие не закончилось, важен период времени: I've been waiting for you for ages.
Present Perfect: have / has + V3. Present Perfect Continuous: have / has been + V-ing.

flashcards.q: Bill (has caught / has been catching) a cold.
He has (lied / has been lying) in bed all day long.
They (have shopped / have been shopping) since the sales started.
They (haven't bought / haven't been buying) anything yet.

timeline.title: Present Perfect
timeline.text: Результат важен: I have already found a T-shirt. Have you tried it on?

timeline.title: Present Perfect Continuous
timeline.text: Период важен: I've been trying on these clothes. You've been choosing for hours.

timeline.title: Законченное действие
timeline.text: I haven't decided yet. Bill has caught a cold.

timeline.title: Незаконченное действие
timeline.text: I've been waiting for you for ages! She has been doing exercises for two weeks.

quiz.q: The action has finished and the result is important. Use…
The action is unfinished and the time period is important. Use…
I … already … a T-shirt for the party.
You … for hours! Come on, decide!

opts: to put on clothes to see if they fit

quiz.q: Someone who does not like waiting is…
